name: Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs
source:
After being lectured by the Yama for being too cold to humans, Sakuya Izayoi decides to change her ways and show her warmth and kindness towards them. With the help of her friends, she's transported into your mind as you fall asleep into a comfy beach scene.

"This is your personal area. You can come back here anytime you want, no matter what."

Enjoy at atmospheric scene with Sakuya as she gives you insight and advice into your troubles, when you're feeling sad, depressed or anxious, Sakuya has some advice and strategies for you to try out. If nothing else, she's got a surprise move for you that's sure to cheer you up. Features very cute ZUN-styled art, an ambient beach scene and practical advice and strategies to help you overcome your troubles.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
十六夜咲夜因对人类过于冷漠而受到魔人的训斥后，决定改变自己的方式，向人类表现出温暖和仁慈。在她朋友的帮助下，当你在舒适的海滩场景中入睡时，她会进入你的脑海。

“这是你的私人区域。无论什么时候，你都可以回到这里。”

与咲夜一起享受氛围场景，她会为你提供有关烦恼的见解和建议，当你感到悲伤、沮丧或焦虑时，咲夜会提供一些建议和策略供你尝试。如果不出意外的话，她会给你带来一个惊喜，一定会让你高兴起来。具有非常可爱的ZUN风格的艺术、环境优美的海滩场景以及帮助你克服麻烦的实用建议和策略。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232180/]Steam[/url]]
